notes:
Beta 1.5.13 - badge icon now shows on cached chats/users.

Fix: server-issued badges previously set the description on ChatFull/UserFull (text was visible in the channel info page), but never wrote bot_verification_icon onto the cached Chat/User objects, so DialogCell drew nothing in the chat list and the channel header had no icon.

Added _patch_server_badges_in_cached_objects that walks the badge cache, resolves each entity via MessagesController (converting -100<id> dialog form back to TLRPC chat id), and applies the badge in place on every poll tick.
